rooms.generationPrompt: Commit a bounded sine or cosine expression with a different integer frequency, then give a short rationale.
rooms.revealMaterial: For y = sin(k*x), nonzero integer k changes period to 2*pi/abs(k) while preserving odd parity. For y = cos(k*x), it changes period the same way while preserving even parity. Adding unlike sine and cosine terms usually yields neither parity.
